name: d3-ultra
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B (config.json max_position_embeddings 262144). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
attention_variant: hybrid: Gated DeltaNet linear attention with full gated attention every 4th layer (16 of 64); partial RoPE
notes:
ADDED 2026-10-27 from the trending sweep. A DECISION model (task=decision), not a text generator: it reads a state (text or JSON, plus images and videos) and a schema of typed questions - choice up to 255 options, yes/no, score, box, track - and returns a probability per option in ONE forward pass, zero output tokens. Full fine-tune of Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B (board meta kind 'full fine-tune', base_model Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B), so every architecture field above is inherited unchanged from models/qwen3-8-27b. It is the 27B member of the Decision 3.0 family; siblings d3 (27B), d3-turbo (27B), d3-flash (9B), d3-mini (4B), d3-nano (2B), d3-lite (0.8B), d3-edge (0.6B) are all on the board and only the top two are recorded here.

PARAMS: HF safetensors total 26,085,330,160 BF16 = 26.085B, which is BELOW the base's 27.781B. The card explains the difference - 26.09B including a 0.46B vision encoder, and a 255-way readout instead of a full-vocabulary lm_head. The board independently reports served_params 26085330160, agreeing with the safetensors count. active_params_b is left as the base's 27.781 (dense, no MoE) and is NOT meaningful for a single-pass readout; flops_per_token_active is the tool's 6x-active approximation and should be read with that caveat. HARDWARE GATE: passes - active 27.78B <= 40 and 26.085 x 0.5 GiB = ~13 GiB at 4-bit, well under 128 GiB. The card says it is served on one AMD Instinct MI325X.

EVIDENCE PROVENANCE - READ THIS: the benchmark rows are NOT from the model card. They are read from the upstream Decision Index board (huggingface.co/spaces/multimodalart/jev-decision-index, data/index.json, generated 2026-10-26T15:30:58Z, jev_version jev-1.14.0, panel_id decision-index-0.3). The board's row for this engine is not flagged self-reported, the run completed all 110,201 requests with 0 unsupported and 0 error, coverage 1.0, and it names the checkpoint it measured. vendor_claim is therefore set true only because the model's own authors submitted the checkpoint, not because the numbers are their unaudited claims - the distinction matters and the board is the stronger source. Upstream also carries an older per-edition block (data/v03.json) matching the card's 0.3.2 framing.

WHAT IT BEATS AND WHAT IT LOSES, same 0.4.1 board, all rows board-measured: it is rank 2 of 229 by full score (70.18) and is beaten only by models/glide (Fastino GLiDE 1.2, 71.52) - a 1.34 gap. Axis by axis against glide it wins two of five and loses three: it WINS Knowledge 62.32 vs 60.59 (+1.73) and Arts 63.5 vs 62.59 (+0.91), and LOSES Language 72.35 vs 75.49 (-3.14), Retrieval 71.76 vs 72.24 (-0.48) and Tools 87.76 vs 88.04 (-0.28). So the pattern is: d3-ultra wins the knowledge and arts axes, loses language, retrieval and tools, and loses the headline because language carries the same 25.85% weight as knowledge and glide is 3.14 ahead there. It LOSES the public index too (71.57 vs 78.89). Against its own family it WINS clearly: +3.03 full score over d3 (67.15) and +12.17 over Decision 2.0 Vega 27B (58.01). Against models/clef (61.21) no same-edition comparison exists - clef's number is the retired 0.2.1 edition - so none is claimed. It is recorded because it is a top-2 entrant on a board this catalog already ranks in docs/33-decision-models.md and because its card states 66.3 on edition 0.3.2 while the current board puts the same checkpoint at 70.18: a live edition split a reader should be able to see and contradict.

LATENCY/CALIBRATION, both board-measured on 1x NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000: median 200.5 ms, p95 673.5 ms, mean 423.7 ms; ECE 0.0666 at accuracy 0.809, Brier 0.273, 2.04% of rows answered with confidence >0.95. The card's own serving figures (median 54.4 ms text, 290 ms with an image) are on AMD MI325X with AutoModel and measure a different rig, so they are not recorded as rows.
